# Gemara

> GRC Engineering Model for Automated Risk Assessment. Gemara provides a logical model describing categories of compliance activities, how they interact, and schemas enabling automated interoperability between GRC tools. Part of the OpenSSF ecosystem.

Gemara delivers three components: the Model (seven-layer conceptual framework), the Schemas (CUE format for validation and interoperability), and SDKs (language-specific libraries for working with Gemara documents).

The model is organized into Definition layers (1–3) and Measurement layers (5–7), with Layer 4 as the pivot point representing Sensitive Activities.

## The Model

- [Scope](https://gemara.openssf.org/model/01-scope): Purpose and scope of the Gemara model
- [Foundational Concepts](https://gemara.openssf.org/model/03-foundational-concepts): Layered approach inspired by the OSI model; prior art including OSCAL, SCAP, ISO standards
- [The Model](https://gemara.openssf.org/model/04-the-model): Overview of all seven layers and the logical flow between definition and measurement activities
- [Layer 1: Vectors & Guidance](https://gemara.openssf.org/model/05.1-Layer-1): Generic risk assessment; Vectors document attack opportunities; Guidance catalogs provide high-level recommendations (e.g. NIST CSF, OWASP Top 10, HIPAA, GDPR)
- [Layer 2: Threats & Controls](https://gemara.openssf.org/model/05.2-Layer-2): Technology-specific threat-informed controls with assessment requirements (e.g. CIS Benchmarks, FINOS CCC, OSPS Baseline)
- [Layer 3: Risk & Policy](https://gemara.openssf.org/model/05.3-Layer-3): Organizational risk catalogs and policies tailored to risk appetite; bridges hypothetical controls with operational reality
- [Layer 4: Sensitive Activities](https://gemara.openssf.org/model/06-sensitive-activities): Pivot point; any action introducing organizational risk (e.g. software development, infrastructure provisioning)
- [Layer 5: Evaluation](https://gemara.openssf.org/model/07.2-Layer-5): Intent and behavior evaluations producing compliance opinions; includes configuration scanning, penetration testing
- [Layer 6: Enforcement](https://gemara.openssf.org/model/07.3-Layer-6): Preventive enforcement (deployment gates) and remediative enforcement (corrective action post-detection)
- [Layer 7: Audit & Continuous Monitoring](https://gemara.openssf.org/model/07.4-Layer-7): Formal audit of policies and posture; continuous compliance monitoring (CCM) of deployed assets

## Schemas

- [Schema Reference](https://gemara.openssf.org/schema/): CUE schemas for all layers; browse by artifact type
- [Guidance Catalog schema](https://gemara.openssf.org/schema/guidancecatalog): Layer 1
- [Vector Catalog schema](https://gemara.openssf.org/schema/vectorcatalog): Layer 1
- [Principle Catalog schema](https://gemara.openssf.org/schema/principlecatalog): Layer 1
- [Control Catalog schema](https://gemara.openssf.org/schema/controlcatalog): Layer 2
- [Capability Catalog schema](https://gemara.openssf.org/schema/capabilitycatalog): Layer 2
- [Threat Catalog schema](https://gemara.openssf.org/schema/threatcatalog): Layer 2
- [Risk Catalog schema](https://gemara.openssf.org/schema/riskcatalog): Layer 3
- [Policy schema](https://gemara.openssf.org/schema/policy): Layer 3
- [Evaluation Log schema](https://gemara.openssf.org/schema/evaluationlog): Layer 5
- [Enforcement Log schema](https://gemara.openssf.org/schema/enforcementlog): Layer 6
- [Audit Log schema](https://gemara.openssf.org/schema/auditlog): Layer 7
- [CUE Central Registry](https://registry.cue.works/docs/github.com/gemaraproj/gemara@latest): Browse all schemas

## SDK

- [SDK Overview](https://gemara.openssf.org/sdk/): Language-specific libraries; types generated from CUE schemas
- [Go SDK](https://gemara.openssf.org/sdk/go-sdk): Type-safe Go APIs for reading, writing, and manipulating Gemara documents

## Tutorials

- [Tutorials](https://gemara.openssf.org/tutorials/): Hands-on walkthroughs for working with Gemara artifacts

## Optional

- [Community](https://gemara.openssf.org/community/): Meetings, Slack (#gemara on OpenSSF Slack), maintainers
- [Architecture Decision Records](https://gemara.openssf.org/adrs/): Significant design decisions for schemas and tooling
- [GitHub: gemaraproj/gemara](https://github.com/gemaraproj/gemara): CUE schemas and gemara-docs CLI (source of truth for schemas)
- [GitHub: gemaraproj/gemara-mcp](https://github.com/gemaraproj/gemara-mcp): MCP server for AI assistant integration
